name: Bring the Light
summary: Archbishop Bendictus asks you to face Amnennar the Coldbringer in Razorfen Downs. His request makes the archbishop’s concern plain.

sections.title: Bendictus’s Request
sections.body: You are bound for Razorfen Downs at Archbishop Bendictus’s request. He names Amnennar the Coldbringer as the one you are to slay. The archbishop’s concern rests on that foe.

faq.q: Who asks me to go to Razorfen Downs?
faq.answer: Archbishop Bendictus asks you to slay Amnennar the Coldbringer in Razorfen Downs.
Amnennar the Coldbringer is the foe Archbishop Bendictus names for you to slay in Razorfen Downs.
Archbishop Bendictus names Razorfen Downs as the place to find Amnennar the Coldbringer.

attribution: In-game quest text: Bring the Light
